chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Munich, 2025: the Champions League final against Inter. Vitinha passes to Ousmane Dembélé, and keeps running. Dembélé flicks it back into his path. Vitinha charges on… and rolls it through for Désiré Doué!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Vitinha gives the pass, then sprints into space. The flick finds him at full speed.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: Then Vitinha rolls it in front of Doué, racing down the right. First time, far corner! Paris won five–nil, their first Champions League!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: Remember Vitinha: pass and move! Give it, then find a new space to get it back.
